summary_1line: A debate on sacrificial killing and non‑violence is followed by the tale of Karttaviryya Arjuna’s arrogance and his slaying by the warrior-sage Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: A wandering ascetic confronts a priest beside a sacrificial altar where a water-sprinkled goat stands bound amid ritual fires.
The thousand‑armed king Karttaviryya Arjuna stands on the seashore loosing volleys of arrows into the ocean as waves rise around him.
Parashurama, blazing with fury, swings his battle‑axe and fells the many‑armed king like a giant tree collapsing to the ground.
